# SEF RIFA foreign-resident stocks, 2017–2022

The former Serviço de Estrangeiros e Fronteiras (SEF) published annual
*Relatórios de Imigração, Fronteiras e Asilo* (RIFA). These are original
administrative reporting vintages for **foreign residents with residence
authorisations**, not a harmonized series of migrant arrivals or foreign-born
population. The [AIMA migration observatory](https://om.aima.gov.pt/index.php/2025/10/30/relatorios-de-imigracao-fronteiras-e-asilo/)
provides an official historical report collection.

## Source family

| Reference year | Original SEF PDF |
| --- | --- |
| 2017 | [RIFA 2017](https://om.aima.gov.pt/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Rifa_2017.pdf) |
| 2018 | [RIFA 2018](https://sefstat.sef.pt/Docs/Rifa2018.pdf) |
| 2019 | [RIFA 2019](https://sefstat.sef.pt/Docs/Rifa2019.pdf) |
| 2020 | [RIFA 2020](https://sefstat.sef.pt/Docs/Rifa2020.pdf) |
| 2021 | [RIFA 2021](https://sefstat.sef.pt/Docs/Rifa2021.pdf) |
| 2022 | [RIFA 2022, official AIMA archive](https://om.aima.gov.pt/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Rifa_2022.pdf) |

The `empirical-analysis-r` project records original and archived URLs in
`studies/portugal-migration/data/README.md` and
`aima_source_catalogue.csv`, including an Arquivo.pt capture of the
original 2022 PDF and Internet Archive captures of certain earlier reports.
The original sources publish both **Stock** and **Fluxos**; the research
uses Stock observations for its 12 selected nationalities, plus historical
top-ten summaries and an independently calculated residual.

| Original report year | Resident stock (people) |
| --- | ---: |
| 2017 | 421,711 |
| 2018 | 480,300 |
| 2019 | 590,348 |
| 2020 | 662,095 |
| 2021 | 698,887 |
| 2022 | 781,915 |

The 2022 annex separately records `Stock` and `Fluxos` by nationality and
sex. **British Subject** is a distinct nationality row and is not silently
combined with `Reino Unido`. Each report's `Other` top-ten category depends
on that year's ranked list; it is not the same as the project's 12-country
derived residual.

**External-only rights decision.** The PDFs and downstream transcribed
tables are not copied into this registry without verified permission for
their redistribution. Source years, vintages and definitions must be kept
when comparing later AIMA revisions.
